Morgan Stanley upgraded AMAT to "Overweight" with a $209 price target, while Stifel and Needham maintained "Buy" ratings, raising targets to $215 and $260, respectively. This positive analyst sentiment, amidst recent market volatility related to U.S.-China trade tensions, reflects a bullish outlook for the company.

title: Why Datadog (DDOG) Stock Is Up Today - TradingView
summary: Datadog (DDOG) shares rose by 2.9% after the company announced expanded support and new integrations for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), specifically enhancing AI and machine learning workload management. These new features include GPU Monitoring, Cloud Cost Management, and Cloud SIEM, positioning Datadog as a key observability vendor for OCI's AI infrastructure. This positive development follows a contract renewal with OpenAI and increased price targets from analysts, reinforcing investor confidence in the company's growth in cloud consumption and service usage.

title: US Equity Indexes Rebound After Bessent Calms China Trade Tensions - MarketScreener
summary: US equity indexes rebounded after Bessent's comments helped ease China trade tensions. This news comes after a period of trade rhetoric influencing market performance. The S&P 500, Dow Jones Industrial, and NASDAQ 100 all showed gains.

title: UBER Soars 55% YTD: How Should Investors Play the Stock Now?
summary: Uber Technologies (UBER) shares have soared 55% year-to-date, driven by strong growth in mobility and delivery gross bookings, strategic partnerships for drone delivery and grocery expansion, and robust financial performance including significant share buyback authorizations. Despite these positives, concerns exist regarding Uber's high debt load and premium valuation compared to its industry peers. Investors are advised to hold existing shares, but potential new investors might consider waiting for a more attractive entry point due to valuation and debt levels.

title: GPT‑5 cuts political bias by 30%, according to OpenAI — here’s what that means - Windows Central
summary: OpenAI claims its new AI model, GPT-5, reduces political bias by 30% compared to previous versions, striving for objectivity. The internal evaluation tested 500 prompts across 100 political and cultural topics, primarily focused on U.S. issues. While the company highlights progress, the study's internal nature and limitations regarding its U.S.-centric dataset and exclusion of web search elements raise questions about its comprehensive neutrality.

title: Premium And AI Phones Powered Global Smartphone Sales In 2025
summary: Global smartphone shipments increased by 2.6% in Q3 2025, driven by strong demand for premium and AI-powered devices from companies like Apple and Samsung. Despite economic uncertainties, consumers are investing in high-end smartphones, indicating market resilience and sustained growth for the tech sector. This trend highlights how innovation and strategic promotions can overcome broader economic challenges.

title: I tested OpenAI Sora 2 vs Google Veo 3 for AI video, and there’s a very clear winner - Mashable
summary: This article compares OpenAI's Sora 2 and Google's Veo 3 AI video generators through a series of six prompts. The author concludes that Google's Veo 3 is the clear winner for professional use due to its higher quality and versatility, while Sora 2's primary advantage is its ability to create personalized "cameo" videos. The comparison highlights differences in realism, physics handling, audio generation, and copyright material sensitivity between the two models.

title: Salesforce joins AI spending splurge with $15 billion commitment to San Francisco - Cryptopolitan
summary: Salesforce has announced a $15 billion commitment to San Francisco over five years to boost AI innovation and support local economic growth. This investment will fund an AI incubator hub, create jobs, and advance the company's Agentforce 360 platform. Salesforce's move is part of a larger trend among tech giants, including OpenAI, AMD, Nvidia, Oracle, and Meta Platforms, who are collectively investing billions into AI, cloud, and chip infrastructure.

title: Resources Connection RGP Earnings Transcript - AOL.com
summary: Resources Connection (RGP) reported better-than-expected fiscal first-quarter results for 2025, driven by strong gross margin and cost controls, even as revenue growth remained soft in some segments. The company highlighted growth in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and outsourced services, alongside improved average bill rates and pipeline momentum in digital transformation and CFO advisory services. Management also announced a cost reduction effort expecting $6 million to $8 million in annual savings, aiming for stabilized performance despite a volatile market.

title: Want to Stay on Windows 10 for Free? Do This by Tomorrow to Extend Your Support - PCMag Middle East
summary: As Windows 10 officially ends support on October 14, Microsoft offers three ways for users to extend critical security updates for another year. Two of these options are free for individual users: redeeming 1,000 Microsoft Rewards points or syncing Windows Backup to Microsoft OneDrive. The third option involves paying $30 for the Extended Security Updates (ESU) program.

title: Microsoft AI announces first image generator created in-house
summary: Microsoft AI has launched its first in-house text-to-image generator, MAI-Image-1, which the company claims excels at photorealistic imagery and processes requests faster than larger models. The new AI model has already achieved a top 10 ranking on LMArena, an AI benchmark site. This development follows Microsoft's earlier investments in AI training capacity and complements its existing AI products like MAI-Voice-1 AI and chatbot MAI-1-preview.

title: Woodward (WWD) Stock Is Up, What You Need To Know - Yahoo Finance
summary: Woodward (WWD) stock jumped 2.6% after President Trump's softened stance on U.S.-China trade relations eased market fears, causing broad market indices to rise. This positive investor sentiment followed a period of steep losses due to escalating trade tensions. Woodward's shares are up 48.3% year-to-date and have shown significant growth over the past five years.

title: Asana and Teradata Shares Are Soaring, What You Need To Know
summary: Shares of Asana and Teradata rallied following President Trump's eased rhetoric on trade tensions with China, which provided significant relief to investors. This market recovery saw technology stocks like AMD and Nvidia also climb, reversing a sharp sell-off from previous tariff threats. The article highlights the volatility of Asana's shares and its year-to-date performance.

title: BatchOutput for Microsoft PowerPoint Now Supports macOS Tahoe - openPR.com
summary: Zevrix Solutions has released BatchOutput PPT 2.2.26, an update to its automation solution for Microsoft PowerPoint on macOS, adding support for the new macOS 26 Tahoe. This software automates professional PDF production and printing directly from PowerPoint, offering features like variable PDF file naming, splitting files into single-page PDFs, and PDF encryption. BatchOutput PPT is available for US$19.95 and requires macOS 10.9 - 26.x and Microsoft PowerPoint 2011 or later.

title: Snap, Bumble, and Shutterstock Shares Skyrocket, What You Need To Know - Yahoo
summary: Shares of Snap, Bumble, and Shutterstock surged after President Trump's conciliatory comments eased concerns about US-China trade tensions, leading to a broader market recovery. This rally, following a previous drop due to trade war fears, highlights the market's sensitivity to geopolitical developments and investors' "buy-the-dip" mentality. Shutterstock, for example, saw its shares jump 3%, despite being down 21.5% year-to-date and 33.7% below its 52-week high.

title: Microsoft prepares to officially transition Windows 10 into “end of life” status, effective October 14
summary: Microsoft is transitioning Windows 10 to "end of life" status on October 14, ending regular security updates and increasing vulnerability. While users can upgrade to Windows 11 or replace hardware, a free Extended Security Updates (ESU) program provides an additional year of security patches for consumers who opt into Microsoft's cloud services. This offers a temporary solution, but a permanent upgrade or hardware replacement remains inevitable for long-term security and functionality.

title: A10 Networks: A Smart Strategy, But The Price Already Reflects It (NYSE:ATEN) - Seeking Alpha
summary: A10 Networks is successfully transitioning to enterprise and AI-focused cybersecurity, demonstrating strong financial performance and a growing customer base, further enhanced by its recent acquisition of ThreatX. Despite these positive developments, the company's stock is currently trading at a premium valuation, with much of the anticipated 2026 growth already factored into its price. The article maintains a "Hold" rating due to limited upside and potential dilution from convertible debt, cautioning investors ahead of the next earnings report.

title: Windows 10 support ends Oct. 14. Here’s what to do - CP24
summary: Microsoft will end support for Windows 10 on Oct 14, 2025, urging users to upgrade to Windows 11 for critical security updates. For those unable to upgrade due to hardware limitations, an Extended Security Update (ESU) program is available until October 13, 2026, with options for free or paid enrollment. Cybersecurity expert Ritesh Kotak stresses the importance of these updates for computer protection against malware and stability issues.

title: OpenAI Targets Custom Silicon in Broadcom Deal - MarketScreener
summary: OpenAI is reportedly partnering with Broadcom to develop custom silicon for its AI accelerators, indicating a move towards specialized hardware to power its demand for AI infrastructure. This collaboration highlights a broader trend among major AI firms like OpenAI and Meta to invest heavily in their own AI infrastructure. Broadcom shares saw a significant increase on the news of the strategic collaboration and chip pact.

title: Why crypto briefly but dramatically crashed when Trump renewed his trade war - newspressnow.com
summary: Cryptocurrencies experienced a significant flash crash, leading to $19 billion in liquidated positions, when President Donald Trump threatened new trade tariffs. This event caused investors to abandon riskier assets like crypto, exacerbating the crash due to highly leveraged trading positions. While prices have somewhat rebounded, the incident highlighted the inherent volatility and technical vulnerabilities within the crypto market.

title: EFF and Five Human Rights Organizations Urge Action Around Microsoft’s Role in Israel’s War on Gaza - Electronic Frontier Foundation
summary: The Electronic Frontier Foundation (EFF) and five other human rights organizations have urged Microsoft to clarify its role and take further action regarding its AI and cloud computing technologies used in Israel's war on Gaza. This call follows Microsoft's announcement that it has ceased some services to a unit within the Israel Ministry of Defense after reports emerged of the IDF using Azure for mass surveillance. The organizations also renewed calls to Google and Amazon to address similar concerns regarding their involvement in human rights abuses.

title: Microsoft outlines ambitious post-quantum plans, but challenges remain - The Strategist | ASPI's analysis and commentary site
summary: Microsoft has set an ambitious goal to complete migration to post-quantum cryptography by 2033, ahead of the 2035 deadline set by most governments. While this initiative is welcomed, the article highlights significant challenges, including uncertainty in quantum attack projections and the need for continuous adaptation due to rapid cryptanalysis developments. It emphasizes that governments and industries must build flexibility, ensure independent assurance, and prioritize crypto-agility to navigate the evolving post-quantum landscape.

title: LSEG and Microsoft Partner to Help Financial Institutions Build AI Agents - PYMNTS.com
summary: LSEG and Microsoft have partnered to provide financial institutions with access to AI-ready data and enable agentic workflows. This collaboration allows LSEG customers to build AI agents using LSEG's licensed data within Microsoft's Copilot Studio and leverage the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for enhanced interoperability. The initiative aims to transform data access for financial professionals through AI-driven innovation, building on LSEG's previous AI-focused partnerships with Databricks and Rogo.

title: Intrusion Inc. (INTZ) Exceeds Market Returns: Some Facts to Consider
summary: Intrusion Inc. (INTZ) recently closed at $1.77, outperforming the S&P 500, Dow, and Nasdaq with a daily gain of 1.72%. The company has seen a 2.96% gain in the past month and is projected to report a significant rise in EPS and revenue for its upcoming earnings disclosure. Despite these positive indicators, it currently holds a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) based on recent downward revisions to analyst EPS estimates.

title: Did ECOC 2025 signal a tilt towards co-packaged optics? - LightCounting
summary: ECOC 2025 indicated a growing industry focus on co-packaged optics, with Nvidia and Meta highlighting its importance for AI systems and power efficiency. Despite a relatively quiet ECOC, significant industry developments occurred prior to the event, including Ciena's acquisition of Nubis Communications and Microsoft's partnerships for hollow-core fiber production. The conference also showcased advancements in multicore and hollow-core fiber and an expected surge in demand for optical circuit switches.

title: Microsoft to Expand AI Access in Washington State Schools - GovTech
summary: Microsoft is launching "Microsoft Elevate Washington," an initiative to provide Washington public school districts and community colleges with free access to AI tools, professional development, and infrastructure support. This program aims to address disparities in AI adoption and position Washington as a leader in AI-augmented education by offering Copilot Studio access, technology consultation, and AI training for educators.

title: OpenAI Gandeng Broadcom For First AI Chip Production, Ready To Compete With Nvidia And AMD - VOI.ID
summary: OpenAI has partnered with Broadcom to produce its first AI processor, aiming to reduce dependence on Nvidia and strengthen control over computing power supply for services like ChatGPT. This collaboration follows other significant investments in the AI chip sector, including deals with AMD and Nvidia, positioning OpenAI to directly compete with cloud giants like Google and Amazon in developing proprietary AI chips. Broadcom's shares surged following the announcement, with full implementation of the custom chip expected by the end of 2029.

title: Is Microsoft’s Valuation Justified After Wayve Funding Talks and AI Growth News? - simplywall.st
summary: This article analyzes Microsoft's current valuation following its funding talks with Wayve and ongoing AI growth. It examines Microsoft's stock performance, market sentiment, and delves into two valuation approaches: Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) analysis and Price vs. Earnings (PE) ratio, concluding with a discussion of "Narratives" for personalized valuation.

title: Is Microsoft’s Valuation Justified After Wayve Funding Talks and AI Growth News? - simplywall.st
summary: This article analyzes Microsoft's current valuation of $514.05 a share amidst recent news like potential funding talks for Wayve and ongoing AI growth. Using a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) analysis, Microsoft appears to be trading near its fair value of $502.05, while a Price-to-Earnings (PE) approach suggests it might be undervalued given its "Fair Ratio" of 56.04x compared to its current 37.52x. The article highlights both bull and bear cases for Microsoft's future valuation, emphasizing the role of AI and cloud expansion in driving potential growth.

title: Nvidia and AMD Could Be the Biggest Winners as Start-Ups Like Groq Push AI Chip Demand Higher
summary: The rise of AI start-ups like Groq, a competitor to Nvidia and AMD, is increasing demand for AI-specific chips, particularly for inference tasks. This expanded market benefits industry leaders Nvidia and AMD, who are capitalizing on this shift by offering specialized AI hardware and forming key partnerships, thus strengthening their positions in the evolving AI landscape. While Groq's success creates market diversification and reduces antitrust risks for Nvidia, the established players' financial power allows them to maintain their lead in AI technology development.

title: Microsoft to bring AI to WA classrooms amid urban, rural tech divide - The Spokesman-Review
summary: Microsoft is set to provide its AI technology to all public school districts and community colleges in Washington state, as part of a nationwide initiative to promote AI training and usage. The program, Microsoft Elevate Washington, aims to bridge the technology gap between urban and rural areas by offering AI tools, training, and $25,000 grants. This move reflects Microsoft's belief that AI proficiency will be crucial for the future workforce, despite ongoing debates about the technology's role in education.

title: Microsoft debuts its first in-house AI image generator - Engadget
summary: Microsoft has introduced MAI-Image-1, its first internally developed AI image generator, aimed at producing photorealistic results with natural lighting and landscapes. This move signifies Microsoft's continued effort to decrease reliance on OpenAI, following previous in-house AI model releases. MAI-Image-1 is currently being tested on LMArena and is slated for integration into Copilot and Bing Image Creator soon.

title: Big Money Move: Investment Manager Buys $6.9 Million Worth of Johnson & Johnson Shares, According to Recent Filing
summary: Cyndeo Wealth Partners, LLC reported purchasing 40,238 shares of Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) for an estimated $6.89 million during Q3 2025. This acquisition increased their total JNJ holding to 103,832 shares, valued at $19.25 million, representing 1.07% of their assets under management. The article highlights J&J's strong performance, attractive dividend yield, and relatively affordable valuation despite ongoing litigation risks.

title: Big Money Move: Investment Manager Buys $6.9 Million Worth of Johnson & Johnson Shares, According to Recent Filing
summary: Cyndeo Wealth Partners recently purchased 40,238 shares of Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) valued at approximately $6.89 million, increasing their total holding to $19.25 million. This investment highlights the firm's conviction in JNJ, which has seen strong stock performance, outperforming the S&P 500, despite ongoing litigation risks. The article suggests JNJ could be an attractive option for value-oriented investors due to its dividend yield and P/E ratio.

title: AI users sue Microsoft in antitrust class action over OpenAI deal - TradingView
summary: Microsoft is facing an antitrust class action lawsuit filed by AI users who allege the company illegally inflated prices for generative AI through a secret exclusive cloud computing agreement with OpenAI. The lawsuit claims Microsoft's $13 billion investment and deal with OpenAI restricted competition, drove up ChatGPT subscription prices, and hurt product quality for users. While Microsoft asserts its partnership promotes competition and innovation, the plaintiffs seek damages for alleged overcharges and a court order to prevent future restrictions.

title: SoundHound AI Stock Skyrockets 240% on AI Boom – Can It 10X Next?
summary: SoundHound AI (SOUN) stock has surged 240% year-to-date, driven by the AI boom and strong business performance, including record Q2 2025 revenue of $42.7M and a $1.2 billion backlog. The company is expanding partnerships with major clients like Red Lobster and Hyundai/Kia, leveraging its proprietary voice AI technology and new agentic AI platform, Amelia 7. Despite its impressive growth and technological advantages, SoundHound remains unprofitable, trading at a high valuation, which analysts view with cautious optimism.

title: Co-working company Kiln opening first Washington state location in tech-heavy Seattle neighborhood - GeekWire
summary: Kiln, a co-working company based in Salt Lake City, is opening its first Washington state location in a tech-heavy neighborhood of Seattle. The new 32,276 square-foot space will accommodate over 350 members and compete with other co-working providers in the Seattle area, which ranks 12th nationally in co-working square footage. This expansion marks Kiln's 25th location overall, with other nearby locations in Portland and Bend, Oregon.

title: How the $381B AI Cloud Deal Is Shaping Oracle’s 2025 Valuation
summary: Oracle's stock has seen significant growth in 2025 due to its push into AI cloud infrastructure, including deals with OpenAI. Despite being considered overvalued by traditional metrics like DCF and PE ratios, the company's valuation is heavily influenced by investor "Narratives" around its potential in the AI-powered cloud market, with fair value estimates ranging from $183 to $333 per share. These diverse outlooks highlight the speculative nature of Oracle's current market perception and future prospects.

title: Elon Musk Targets Hardware and Software With New Microsoft Competitor - Newsweek
summary: Elon Musk's xAI is launching "Macrohard," a new initiative aimed at competing with Microsoft by spanning both software and hardware ecosystems. Macrohard will focus on defining operating systems and product requirements, leveraging third-party manufacturers, similar to Apple's model. xAI plans to develop an AI-centric operating system and aims to release an AI-generated game by the end of next year, supported by its Colossus infrastructure.

title: Microsoft in antitrust lawsuit over its $13bn OpenAI deal - Cryptopolitan
summary: Microsoft is facing a class action lawsuit filed by consumers who allege its $13 billion partnership with OpenAI violates antitrust laws. The lawsuit claims that Microsoft used a secret, exclusive cloud computing deal to limit computational power for OpenAI's platforms, driving up prices and reducing quality for users. Consumers are seeking unspecified damages and a court order to stop Microsoft from enforcing allegedly anti-competitive limits on OpenAI.

title: Microsoft rolls out its first AI model for image creation - SiliconANGLE
summary: Microsoft has launched its first in-house text-to-image AI model, MAI-Image-1, designed for highly photorealistic image generation, avoiding repetitive styles common in other models. This release marks Microsoft's accelerated efforts to establish its own AI model credentials, reducing its reliance on OpenAI. MAI-Image-1 is expected to power image creation features in Microsoft Copilot and Bing Image Creator soon.

title: Datadog launches advanced GPU & cost tools for Oracle Cloud - IT Brief Australia
summary: Datadog has introduced new integrations for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) users, including GPU Monitoring, Cloud Cost Management, and Cloud SIEM, to enhance reliability, optimize costs, and secure AI/ML workloads. These tools offer comprehensive insights into infrastructure health, performance, and spending, facilitating migration to OCI and supporting large-scale AI applications. The expansion reinforces Datadog's focus on unified observability and security across multi-cloud environments.

title: Support for Windows 10 ends: What now? - NonStop Local Billings
summary: Microsoft is ending support for Windows 10, leaving many users with security vulnerabilities. While an upgrade to Windows 11 is an option, many computers are incompatible, even newer ones. Alternatives like paid extended security updates or free open-source operating systems such as Linux are available to keep older machines functional and secure.
